statement: There exist oracles A and B such that P^A = NP^A and P^B ≠ NP^B.
consequence: Any proof technique that remains valid after arbitrary oracle relativization cannot settle P vs NP.

membershipTest.question: Does the proposed technique continue to work in the presence of an arbitrary oracle?

promotionRule.EVADES: require evasionProofId citing the non-relativizing ingredient
